resources.string: Could not connect to the internet. Check your network connection and try again.
None of your enabled hosts sources could be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
Could not create the hosts file
The new hosts file could not be created in the app storage. Check that your device has enough free space.
There is not enough space on the system partition for the hosts file. Enable the Magisk \"Systemless hosts\" module, then restart your device.
Could not install the new hosts file
The hosts file could not be written to the system partition. Enable the Magisk \"Systemless hosts\" module, then restart your device.
Could not restore the hosts file
The default hosts file could not be restored.
Could not start VPN ad blocking
Make sure AdAway is allowed to use the VPN in your device\'s VPN settings.
Could not stop VPN ad blocking
Turn off the VPN manually in your device\'s VPN settings.
